definitions.confirmed: def.conf != null && def.conf.claim.mandateHash == eng.mandateId && def.conf.claim.city == mandate.constraints.city && def.conf.claim.checkIn == mandate.constraints.checkIn && def.conf.claim.checkOut == mandate.constraints.checkOut && amt(def.conf.claim.total.value, 'RLUSD') == def.booked && def.deposit <= amt(mandate.constraints.maxDeposit.value, 'RLUSD')
definitions.disputeOpen: ledger.credentialExists(eng.parties.principal, eng.account, 'ENG/DISPUTE') && size(def.disputes) > 0 && def.balance >= def.booked + (def.checkedIn ? def.deposit : zero('RLUSD')) + amt(params.minDisputeBond, 'RLUSD')
definitions.conceded: def.entryDispute && att.list('party.concession/1', 'counterparty').exists(c, def.disputes.exists(d, d.claim.phase == 'entry' && d.id == c.claim.disputeRef))
definitions.disputeOpenedAt: size(def.settlementDisputes) > 0 ? (timestamp(def.settlementDisputes[0].issuedAt) > timestamp(eng.timers.deliveryBy) ? timestamp(def.settlementDisputes[0].issuedAt) : timestamp(eng.timers.deliveryBy)) : (timestamp(def.entryDisputes[0].issuedAt) > timestamp(eng.timers.checkIn) ? timestamp(def.entryDisputes[0].issuedAt) : timestamp(eng.timers.checkIn))

rules.message: The hotel's confirmation must reference the guest's mandate.

rules.check: def.conf.claim.city == mandate.constraints.city && def.conf.claim.checkIn == mandate.constraints.checkIn && def.conf.claim.checkOut == mandate.constraints.checkOut
rules.message: City and dates must match the mandate.
The confirmed total must equal the booked amount.
The deposit may not exceed the mandate's maxDeposit.
The hotel must record the guest as checked in.
The account must hold the room plus exactly the confirmed deposit.
An agreed settlement is a close.split Batch.
The service fee is 50 bps of everything the hotel receives.
A stay that happened settles with the guest's review.
Settlement pays only the guest, the hotel and the fee account.
Needs an open entry dispute and the hotel's concession referencing it.
A conceded refund is a close.refundAll Batch.
Everything in the account goes to the guest, with no fee.
Refund only after confirmBy when the booking was never confirmed.
The account must hold exactly the room amount.
The refund default is a close.refundAll Batch.
No-show only after both checkInBy and entryDisputeBy.
Only a confirmed booking can be a no-show.
The guest was recorded as checked in.
A guest dispute is open.
The account must hold exactly the room amount.
The no-show default is a close.releaseAll Batch.
The service fee is 50 bps of everything the hotel receives.
Release only after the dispute window, for a stay that happened.
A guest dispute is open.
The account must hold exactly the room plus the deposit.
The release default is a close.releaseWithDeposit Batch.
The hotel posted a deposit claim; it goes to settlement or a ruling.

rules.check: def.toGuest == def.deposit && def.toFee == bps(def.toMerchant + def.toFee, params.serviceFeeBps)
rules.message: The deposit returns to the guest; the room goes to the hotel less the fee.

rules.check: (def.disputeOpen && now > def.disputeOpenedAt + duration(params.rulingWindow)) || (def.claim != null && !def.disputeOpen && now > timestamp(eng.timers.disputeWindowEnds) + duration(params.rulingWindow))
rules.message: The backup arbiter may rule only after the primary's ruling window.
The primary arbiter has ruled.
Needs a ruling from the backup arbiter.

rules.check: size(def.backupRuling.claim.payouts) == tx.payouts.count() && def.backupRuling.claim.payouts.all(p, def.backupRuling.claim.payouts.filter(q, q.to == p.to).size() == 1 && tx.payouts.to(p.to, 'RLUSD') == amt(p.value, 'RLUSD')) && tx.payouts.destinations().all(d, def.backupRuling.claim.payouts.exists(p, p.to == d))
rules.message: The transaction must pay exactly the backup ruling's payouts.
A ruling is a close.split Batch.
The service fee is 50 bps of everything the hotel receives.
A default ruling needs a posted claim.
The guest disputed; the arbiter rules on the dispute instead.
The guest may answer the claim until disputeWindowEnds.
Claims are capped at the deposit.

rules.check: def.toMerchant + def.toFee == def.booked + def.claimTotal && def.toGuest == def.deposit - def.claimTotal && def.toFee == bps(def.toMerchant + def.toFee, params.serviceFeeBps)
rules.message: Room plus claim to the hotel (less fee), the deposit remainder to the guest.
